title: ophrys umbilicata subsp. bucephala
intro: Ophrys umbilicata subsp. bucephala, commonly known as the Bee Orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an antispasmodic, sedative, and diuretic, making it a possible treatment for various health conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and urinary disorders. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys umbilicata subsp. bucephala include its ability to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and promote urine production. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
